DETAIL: [APPLICABILITY] MainShape/sh:sparql/sh:select: The applicability condition requires only that nltl:tankType exists, but never restricts its value to the two required tank categories; instead it tests unrelated rdf:type assertions. A tank with an arbitrary tankType value can therefore be treated as applicable, while a required tank lacking that extra property can be skipped. Required change: Encode the tank-type applicability directly through the canonical nltl:tankType representation, explicitly limiting it to oil residue tanks and oily bilge water holding tanks, and remove the unconstrained existence check and unrelated substitute classification. Locked resolution: use exactly https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#tankType. | [MISSING_VALUE_BEHAVIOR] MainShape/sh:sparql/sh:select: The mandatory nltl:individualTankCapacity and quantity-value triples are required for the SPARQL solution to exist, so a relevant tank with missing capacity is silently ignored rather than producing a conformance failure or an explicit incomplete-input result. Required change: Ensure each applicable tank cannot bypass validation when its individual capacity is absent or unusable; enforce the required capacity input before evaluating the >30 m3 exception.
